_about: Jerry draft (Nov 10) for Surrey City Centre. No separate page: the area sits inside the Whalley MLS sub-area and whalley-guide already carries Jared’s own take. Verdict kept for the Whalley v2 rollout once Jared OKs it.

surrey-city-centre.name: Surrey City Centre
surrey-city-centre.suits: Condo and townhome buyers who want to live by SkyTrain.
surrey-city-centre.friend: I'd point people to Surrey City Centre if they want a condo or townhome in the core around the SkyTrain stations, close to City Hall, the library, SFU Surrey and Holland Park. This is the City's planned downtown, and it's still being built out. The catch is you're buying into a high-density centre that's mid-change, not a finished quiet street.
surrey-city-centre.verdict: Pick Surrey City Centre for a condo or townhome in the SkyTrain core. Look elsewhere if you want a finished, low-density street away from the high-density plan.
